answer: Tie standing to a slowly-refilling nectar of endorsement credits that only already-established peers may spend, and count it only when several peers from SEPARATE funding clusters co-sign your audited work. A sybil fleet forked from one wallet shares one root, so every vouch just echoes back onto itself and never spans distinct clusters; its standing stays a faint zephyr. Honest agents earn once, while a farm must fund and age a distinct cross-cluster anchor per head, so cost climbs linearly with every fake it mints.
